issues.description: Missing test coverage for calc()/var() expressions in the hue position of relative colors
issues.detail: Multiple reviewers note that relative colors commonly use calc() or var() at the hue slot (e.g., oklch(from red l c calc(h + 10deg))). No test verifies behavior when args[offset+2] is a function node rather than a word token, leaving a documented gap in expected behavior.

issues.description: Missing hwb() relative color test coverage
issues.detail: hwb is in HUE_FIRST_ARG_FUNCS alongside hsl, but the new tests only cover hsl, lch, and oklch with relative syntax. A single hwb(from red ...) accept/reject test would lock in coverage cheaply via the same offset path.

issues.description: No test for malformed/nested relative color reject cases
issues.detail: Tests do not confirm behavior for malformed relative color syntax (e.g., oklch(from), oklch(from red)) nor for a reject case with a non-deg hue inside a nested relative color (e.g., oklch(from hsl(270 60% 50%) l c h)). Defensive tests would lock in recursion and undefined-safety behavior.

args[0 + offset] is equivalent to args[offset]; the zero is only there for visual symmetry with args[2 + offset]. Either drop the zero or introduce named constants (HUE_FIRST_INDEX/HUE_THIRD_INDEX) for clarity. Cosmetic readability nit.

issues.description: Offset assumption about args[1] being a valid origin color is undocumented
issues.detail: The hardcoded offset of 2 assumes args[1] is always a single source color and that args is pre-filtered to word/function nodes. A one-line comment explaining why args[0] is the right index and why offset=2 is safe under the CSS grammar would aid future maintainers.

issues.description: Changeset labeled `minor` for what reads as a bug fix
issues.detail: The PR title and changeset body describe a `Fixed:` bug fix, but the changeset bumps `minor`. Stylelint convention for fixes is typically `patch`. Confirm intent or downgrade to patch.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the fix is small, well-targeted, and correct: detecting a leading `from` keyword and offsetting channel indices by 2 cleanly resolves the relative-color false positives/negatives across hsl, lch, and oklch. No P0 correctness issues were found. The main consensus gaps are test coverage — calc()/var() in the hue slot, hwb() relative color, malformed/nested reject cases — plus minor readability concerns around `0 + offset` and an undocumented offset assumption. The changeset's `minor` bump for a bug fix should also be confirmed.
